privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: Congo Developer Club respects your privacy. This policy explains what information may be collected through this website, why it is used, and the choices available to you.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We may receive information that you choose to provide when you contact us, register for an activity, or apply to join the community.
items: Identity and contact details, such as your name and email address.
Professional information that you voluntarily share.
Technical data required for the security and operation of the website.

sections.title: How we use information
items: To respond to your requests and communicate with you.
To organize community programs, activities, and membership.
To maintain, protect, and improve our website.

sections.title: Sharing and retention
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. It may be shared only with service providers needed to operate our services, or when required by law. We retain information only for as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may ask to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you. You may also object to or limit certain uses of your information by contacting us.

terms.title: Legal Notice
terms.introduction: This website presents Congo Developer Club, its mission, activities, and community initiatives. By using it, you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: Website publisher
paragraphs: The website is published by Congo Developer Club, a developer community based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The publication team can be contacted by email.

sections.title: Content and availability
paragraphs: We strive to provide accurate and current information, but cannot guarantee that every page is complete or free from errors. Content and services may be changed, suspended, or removed without notice.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Unless otherwise stated, the website's original text, visual identity, and other content belong to Congo Developer Club. Reuse requires prior authorization, except where applicable law permits it.

sections.title: External links and liability
paragraphs: Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience. Congo Developer Club does not control their content or privacy practices and is not responsible for damage resulting from their use.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.introduction: This policy explains how cookies and similar browser storage may be used when you visit the Congo Developer Club website.

sections.title: What is a cookie?
paragraphs: A cookie is a small text file stored by your browser. It can remember information between pages or visits and help a website function correctly.

sections.title: Cookies we use
items: Essential cookies needed for security and basic website operation.
Preference cookies used to remember choices such as language and visual theme.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Some external services linked or embedded on the website may set their own cookies. Their use is governed by the privacy policies of those providers.

sections.title: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can review, block, or delete cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential storage may prevent some website features from working as intended.

items.name: Ir Musande Augustin
items.quote: Congo Developers Club has been a true accelerator in my tech journey. I learned, shared my knowledge, and met passionate people who inspired me to take my projects further. It is a community that encourages growth, collaboration, and innovation.

items.name: Ir Baraka Kinywa
items.quote: Congo Developers Club opened the door to my first professional experience at EvoluData as a junior developer. It was an opportunity that marked the beginning of my journey in tech.

items.name: Ir Lens Mutombo
items.quote: Congo Developers Club is the most active tech community in the DRC, with incredible networking opportunities.
